ess-beta-metadata.label: Change in dwelling stock (England)
ess-beta-metadata.subtitle: Annual change to the housing stock per 1,000 dwellings
ess-beta-metadata.sourceOrg: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
ess-beta-metadata.longDescription: This indicator shows the annual change to the housing stock (including new builds, conversions, changes of use, other gains/losses and offset by demolitions) per 1,000 dwellings, in England, for financial years ending from 2002 to 2025.
ess-beta-metadata.caveats:
In November 2026, this indicator was renamed from ‘Net additions to the housing stock (England)’ to ‘Change in dwelling stock (England)’.

Net additional dwellings per 1,000 stock are available at an England, regional and local authority district level in MHCLG [net additional dwellings interactive dashboard](https://app.powerbi.com/view?r=eyJrIjoiZTE5YWQ3MDYtZmFjMC00N2YwLWIxM2EtYWY2NTk1NjExYjgwIiwidCI6ImJmMzQ2ODEwLTljN2QtNDNkZS1hODcyLTI0YTJlZjM5OTVhOCJ9).
